name: test
argv:
set -e; source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash; source /driver_work/install/setup.bash; if test -f /candidate-install/setup.bash; then source /candidate-install/setup.bash; fi; unset ROS_STATIC_PEERS ROS_LOCALHOST_ONLY FASTRTPS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE FASTDDS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE CYCLONEDDS_URI; export ROS_DOMAIN_ID=232 RMW_IMPLEMENTATION=rmw_fastrtps_cpp ROS_AUTOMATIC_DISCOVERY_RANGE=LOCALHOST PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 ROS_LOG_DIR=/review-evidence/roslogs XML_CATALOG_FILES=/acceptance-tools/offline-schema/catalog.xml GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=safe.directory GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=/candidate; cd /candidate; set +e
colcon --log-base /review-evidence/test-log test --build-base /candidate-build --install-base /candidate-install --packages-select mtc_core_cpp mtc_task_cpp mtc_manipulation_cpp mtc_motion_execution_cpp mtc_moveit_planner mtc_ros2_action_cpp mtc_trajectory_execution_cpp mtc_aubo_fake_integration_cpp --executor sequential --return-code-on-test-failure
rc=$?
printf '%s\n' "$rc" > /review-evidence/test-exit.txt
colcon --log-base /review-evidence/result-log test-result --test-result-base /candidate-build --verbose > /review-evidence/test-results.txt 2>&1
printf '%s\n' "$?" > /review-evidence/test-result-exit.txt
exit "$rc"
